title: Surreal Fantasy Voyage
description: A vibrant surreal scene depicts three red-sailed boats with lotus flowers and figures crossing a swirling blue sea toward a dark gothic castle. In the foreground a woman kneels before a glowing blue patterned cube on a stone pier while a deer-antlered fiery figure holds an open book to the right and celestial bodies float in a colorful cosmic sky.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal fantasy painting shows three traditional red-sailed boats carrying women with giant pink lotus flowers sailing across a swirling ocean toward a towering dark gothic castle with dragons and owls. In the foreground a woman in blue kneels on a stone pier before a glowing blue cube. To the right a majestic antlered figure with flaming horns holds an open magical book. The sky blends a bright sun with green planet and a starry purple cosmos containing floating books and celestial orbs.
